Axiom: The SDD mechanical tools are `gennady` CLI commands. When working IN the gennady repo itself (including any of its worktrees), invoke them repo-relative from the working tree's own root — `npx tsx /cli/gennady.ts ` — never a hardcoded path to a different checkout; this is rewritten to `npx gennady ` by the path-normalizer when the directives are synced into a project. In every OTHER project, invoke the published package: `npx gennady `. Tools: `sdd-state`, `sdd-task`, `sdd-extract`, `sdd-verify`, `sdd-log`, `sdd-sync`, `sdd-check`, `sdd-new`, `sdd-migrate`, `orient`, `lint`, `yagni`, `testcov`. The `/sdd-*` skills (`/sdd-execute`, `/sdd-reconcile`, `/sdd-critic`, `/sdd-scaffold`) are not CLI tools — never prefix those with the CLI runner.
